exposure: Maternal first trimester vitamin D levels (5 groups)
cohort: 154 live-term births at Acibadem Atakent Hospital, Istanbul, Turkey
finding: Associations were observed between low and high maternal 25-hydroxyvitamin D3 levels and fetal growth at birth weight, but there was no difference in birth length.
birth_weight: Neonatal birth weight was statistically significantly different across the vitamin D level groups
